text:
Jordan: Hey team — tool call to /tools/invoice keeps returning a JSON parse error. Not sure if I'm escaping wrong. Payload I send below, server returns 400.

Jordan: ```
'{
  'invoice_id': 1234, // from our system
  'notes': 'Customer paid via ACH',
}'
```

Sophia (Support): @Jordan thanks — can you paste the exact curl or client request you used? also the error response body if available :eyes:

Jordan: sure, here's the curl we use from our CI job:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/tools/invoice \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{ "invoice_id": 1234, "notes": "Customer paid via ACH", }'
```

deploy-bot: ERROR 400 Bad Request - invalid JSON at position 58: unexpected token '}' (tool-args-parser)

Sophia (Support): looks like two things: trailing comma in the object and you might be mixing quote styles when pasting into CI. remove the trailing comma and make sure you send proper double-quoted JSON. quick try:```
{"invoice_id": 1234, "notes": "Customer paid via ACH"}
```

Eli (Infra Eng): Additional note: some CI runners or templating layers will inject quotes or escape sequences. If your job renders a shell command, single quotes around the whole payload are usually fine, but if a variable is interpolated it can break. For reproducible curl, prefer --data-raw and explicit header:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/tools/invoice \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  --data-raw '{"invoice_id":1234,"notes":"Customer paid via ACH"}'
```

Eli (Infra Eng): For programmatic clients, here's a minimal Node repro that fails with the same malformed payload (note how comments/trailing commas break JSON.parse):```
const body = "{ 'invoice_id': 1234, 'notes': 'Paid', }";
JSON.parse(body); // throws
```

Jordan: ok I removed the trailing comma and switched to --data-raw, ran the CI job and the toolcall succeeded (200). Thanks! :relieved:

Sophia (Support): great — can you paste the response? also would you be willing to share the broken CI snippet privately so we can add a note in the docs?

Jordan: response: ```{ "status": "queued", "task_id": "t_01F3..." }``` happy to DM the CI snippet.

Eli (Infra Eng): filing an infra ticket to improve the parser error to call out "trailing comma or comments in JSON" instead of generic parse error. I'll assign to docs for a short section on safe quoting with curl/CI.

Sophia (Support): thanks all — closing here but tag us if it recurs. :thumbsup:
